item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Gita's LED and a cell. The LED has a longer leg and a shorter leg. The cell has a positive terminal and a negative terminal.

Which connection makes the LED glow?

options.A: Longer leg to the negative terminal; shorter leg to the positive terminal.
options.B: Longer leg to the positive terminal; shorter leg to the negative terminal.
options.C: Both legs joined only to the positive terminal.
options.D: Either way round, because an LED glows in both directions.
